jobs.occupation: IoT Services Manager, Nordics, UK & Benelux
jobs.description:
Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. Trackunit specializes in digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry. The construction industry is the least digitalized industry of all. This lack of digitalization has left construction far behind a global economy on the rise and placed the industry as one of the least productive industries too.

We are looking for an IoT Services Manager to own end-to-end customer-facing project management, and IoT technical account management for their region. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for device, fleet, and IoT solution health to our customer as a trusted technical advisor, guiding them from installation through fleet-health optimization and ongoing device lifecycle support.

With locations in Denmark, The UK and The Netherlands, we offer you a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations or remotely. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives on our career site.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• Technical account management or technical advisory experience in an IoT, telematics, or hardware environment.

• Comfortable consulting customer and interpreting fleet-health and technical data to advise customers and benchmark performance against peer accounts.

• Working knowledge of device and firmware management (CAN, MODbus, firmware/FOTA, BLE sensors) sufficient to guide configuration, validation, and troubleshooting.

• Experience in customer-facing project management, installation, or deployment operations.

• Strong organizational skills — comfortable working with multiple concurrent programs at once.

• Skilled at building trusted relationships with both customer technical stakeholders and internal sales, account, and support/engineering teams.

• Professional fluency in either one of the Nordics languages or Dutch, besides English.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted customer partnerships: Serve as the primary technical contact for IoT accounts, understand customer goals and document agreed solutions and priorities.

• Present insights and recommendations: Lead monthly fleet and device health reviews, translating technical findings into business impact, recommended actions and measurable outcomes for operational and executive audiences.

• Own technical configuration: Manage CAN/Modbus profiles, firmware—including FOTA—and device operating modes to keep customer fleets healthy and reporting accurately.

• Drive proactive fleet health: Monitor fleet and device health, investigate non-reporting devices, and proactively identify and resolve risks before they affect customer operations.

• Support quality deployments: Partner with deployment and technical teams to align requirements, validate installation quality and establish reliable data from day one.

• Lead technical escalations: Coordinate resolution across Support, Engineering and delivery teams, maintaining clear accountability, customer communication and follow-through.

• Enable adoption and growth: Guide customers on relevant IoT capabilities, partner with Sales and Customer Success on improvement opportunities, and bring customer feedback into product and service discussions.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

**The question is: Are you in?

**_Trackunit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

__Trackunit also prioritizes providing reasonable accommodations for qualified people with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let our People & Talents team know.

_**About Trackunit

**Trackunit is the leading operating data platform connecting people, assets, and processes in construction.

A global technology company connecting the construction industry - by orchestrating data and infrastructure - to build the most useful industry for the world.

We connect construction through one platform to create a living, evolving ecosystem that delivers data and insights to the off-highway sector. With more than 2 million assets connected and more than 2 billion data points collected each day, we use technology to eliminate downtime, improve safety, and help customers improve the bottom line in a sustainable, cost-effective way

Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for an Associate to join our skilled and dedicated Valuation team in Copenhagen.

The team

The Valuation team is responsible for financial modelling, valuation framework, applied valuations, and supporting investment decisions through business case reviews with reporting to senior management.

The role

You will be responsible for handling and developing the valuation methodologies applied across CIP funds, working with corporate and regional teams to enhance your financial and valuation skills in a varied portfolio of renewable investments.

As part of the final investment decision process, you will be responsible for engaging with the investment teams, providing detailed financial model assumption reviews to ensure consistent and well-documented business cases, and being accountable for delivering key inputs such as discount rate assumptions to become a trusted business partner, supporting our global investment strategy for the investments and funds managed by CIP.

Furthermore, you will participate in ad hoc analyses on, e.g., power markets, hedging strategy, currency swaps, and other financial products.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

• Develop internal valuation methodologies for new types of investments

• Advising the business on valuation issues and methodologies and maintaining CIP’s valuation framework in collaboration with senior stakeholders

• Participating in various ad hoc financial analyses related to, e.g., financial hedging, benchmarking, factor analysis, mean-variance analysis, risk mitigation, etc.

• Developing and reviewing financial models to ensure consistent implementation of best practices

• Participating in the FID process for new assets by conducting assumption review of underlying business cases

• Preparing and coordinating analysis and communication material for decision-makers at the senior management level

You

The ideal candidate holds a university degree in economics, finance, or a similar field and approximately one year of experience in financial analysis and valuation, with solid skills from private equity firms, top consulting firms, or multinationals, ideally within renewables.

You have a very strong theoretical understanding of complex valuation methodologies and can present complex financial and valuation methods simply and clearly to CIP's senior management.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• The ability to navigate and thrive in a high-intensity environment

• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance analysis and modelling, with the judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential information

• Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills

• Used to working in an international setting

• Fluent in English

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Transaction Banking is changing fast, and the way customers connect with their bank is becoming more sophisticated. Danske Bank is bringing its Customer Implementation and Integration areas together under one unit, and we are looking for a leader who can create a shared direction, build a strong leadership team, and make complex customer journeys simpler and more consistent across five markets.

What you will be doing

You will lead a newly unified organisation spanning Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Lithuania, bringing together experienced leaders, specialist teams and distinct capabilities. Reporting directly to the Head of TxB Sales Enablement, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Product, Technology, IT and Tribe organisations to shape end-to-end customer experiences. Your role sits at the intersection of business, operations and technology, and the decisions you make will shape how corporate customers and financial institutions connect with Danske Bank.

More specifically, you will:

• Set the strategic direction and priorities across all five markets

• Build and develop a leadership team grounded in clarity, empowerment and accountability

• Connect Customer Implementation and Integration to create more seamless customer journeys

• Partner with IT and Tribe teams to shape customer-facing solutions and internal tooling

• Use client insights to inform implementation journeys, integration solutions and commercial priorities

• Encourage the responsible adoption of AI to simplify processes and build employee capabilities

About you

• Solid experience leading organisations through other leaders

• Genuine commitment to developing people, teams and leadership cultures

• Ability to create direction across countries or complex organisational structures

• Skilled at translating strategy into clear priorities and tangible outcomes

• Strong customer and commercial orientation

• Comfortable at the intersection of business, operations and technology

• Able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations

You do not need to come from a traditional banking background. Experience from financial services, consulting, technology, transformation, customer implementation, integrations, APIs, cash management or similar environments is equally relevant and welcome.

What we offer you

This is a rare opportunity to shape a newly formed organisation and leave a lasting mark on how Danske Bank delivers for its customers. You will work in a hybrid model, typically three to four days per week in the office, alongside talented colleagues across multiple markets. We invest in our leaders and offer genuine scope to grow, both in the role and across the wider organisation.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right move for you, we encourage you to apply. You are also welcome to reach out to Natasha Rajovic, Head of TxB Sales Enablement, at nkuz@danskebank.dk with any questions before applying.

Location: Aarhus or Copenhagen.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Senior Software Engineer, Digital Assets

Danske Bank's Digital Assets team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong C#/.NET experience. You will build dependable backend services, connect systems and contribute to our technical decisions and engineering practices.

The role

Your work will include designing and developing an orchestration layer linking core banking systems with custody, wallet and blockchain services. Secure APIs, messaging, data handling and reliable transaction processing will be central to the role.

Working closely with the Technical Lead and Product Owner, you will take solutions from design through implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support. You will also collaborate with specialists in architecture, security and operations across the bank.

What you bring

• Proven C# and modern .NET skills, demonstrated through backend software you have delivered and supported in production.

• Good API design and integration skills, covering REST, service authentication and asynchronous communication.

• Experience with relational data modelling and SQL, including transaction handling and query performance.

• Practical knowledge of automated testing, containers, CI/CD and diagnosing services in production.

• The judgement to turn incomplete requirements into testable delivery steps, explain trade-offs, seek feedback and take ownership of your work.

• Clear spoken and written English, with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

We encourage continuous learning and thoughtful use of development tools, including AI, alongside sound review and testing habits.

Your day-to-day work

• Develop and maintain C#/.NET backend services with clear interfaces and maintainable code.

• Build the orchestration services connecting core banking systems to external digital-asset platforms.

• Design relational data models and use SQL for consistent, efficient data handling.

• Implement integrations through REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks and messaging, using authentication such as OAuth 2.0 and mutual TLS.

• Build idempotent transaction workflows with clear status tracking, retry behaviour and operational exception handling.

• Work with security specialists to integrate established signing and key-management services, applying least privilege, separation of duties and secure credential handling. Ensure signing operations remain auditable.

• Write unit and integration tests and contribute to peer reviews.

• Help automate builds and releases through CI/CD and containerised deployment.

• Instrument services with logs, metrics and alerts, investigate issues and improve reliability and performance.

• Document design decisions, share knowledge and support colleagues through mentoring.

Useful additional experience

Previous blockchain experience is not required. Any of the following would be an advantage:

• Cloud and delivery: infrastructure as code, container platforms, performance testing, monitoring or recovery planning.

• Wallet and custody connectivity: working with provider APIs, SDKs and webhooks for wallet provisioning, transaction submission and status updates.

• Signing and key protection: hardware security modules (HSMs), multi-party computation (MPC), PKCS#11, key derivation using BIP32 or SLIP-0010, or controls for key lifecycle management, backup and recovery.

• Blockchain transactions: Ethereum or other EVM-compatible networks, ERC-20 transfers, gas and nonce handling, finality or chain reorganisations.

• Banking and payment systems: core-banking integration, SEPA Instant or financial messaging based on ISO 20022.

• Regulated software delivery: familiarity with AML/KYC, the Travel Rule, on-chain screening, MiCA or DORA.

Why join the team

• Influence over solution design, technical choices and engineering practices.

• Hands-on development alongside our Technical Lead, Product Owner and colleagues across the bank.

• The opportunity to deepen your knowledge of digital assets within an established financial institution.

• Scope to share your expertise, mentor others and improve how the team builds, tests and runs software.

Workplace and application

Location: Denmark

Workplace: Hybrid setup, 3 days a week in office.

Relocation: No relocation or visa sponsorship offered

Sounds interesting?

Please submit your motivated application and your CV as soon as possible.

Application deadline is November 11th. Interviews will be helt through-out November

If you have any questions, please reach out to Søren Ørding Olsen sreo@danskebank.dk or Philip Nedergaard Hjulskov phhj@danskebank.dk

SmallClaims is a legal tech company that recovers small, valid claims of up to €25,000 through the courts. Claims that businesses write off today because pursuing them costs more than they are worth. Our AI agents run the whole process, from legal assessment and settlement to filing, judgment and enforcement, while our in-house lawyers quality-assure the work and appear in court. That has cut manual case handling from over 15 hours to about 1.5 hours per case. We have handled 5,000+ cases, win 90%+ in court and serve 500+ Danish customers. Case intake has grown more than 370% since 2023, and we have just raised €2M from Vendep Capital to grow in Europe. Now we are growing the engineering team.

**THE ROLE

**Full-time, in-house. You take ownership of your own areas within our AI service (Python/FastAPI, LLM pipelines) and our back-office platform, the tool our case managers and lawyers run the operation on. Ideas take form together with the team, product specialists and the CTO. You take them from there, end to end across the stack: shape, build, ship, verify, follow up.

**What You’ll Work On

**

• Own parts of and build features in our AI service: LLM orchestration with structured outputs, tool calling, and complex agentic workflows.

• Build the back-office platform our case managers and lawyers use every day, and talk to them to find out what they really need.

• Set up and improve evals and observability, so we know our agents are right before we scale them.

• Ship and run what you build, from staging to production on AWS, with tests and CI as a habit.

**What We Work With

**

• Stack: Laravel/PHP, Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Google.

• How we build: Coding agents are part of daily work here. We expect you to be ahead of the curve on building with AI, not catching up to it.

**Who You Are

**

• 3+ years building and operating software in production, from a startup, a bigger company, open source or other serious project.

• You think like a product owner. You want responsibility and ownership, and you take a complicated problem to a shipped feature.

• You are good with data: you understand complex data sets and data pipelines, and you can build with them, visualise them and explain them.

• You hold strong opinions lightly. You are direct in disagreement, but easy to work with after the decision.

• You communicate directly and are honest about mistakes. You can talk to real users and are comfortable with shifting priorities.

• You love building, love learning, and are curious about the domain itself: the legal process, not just the tech.

**Experience And Skills

****Must have

**

• Strong backend development, incl. background jobs, auth models and API design.

• Solid relational database experience (Postgres/SQL or similar): schema design, migrations, performance.

• Hands-on LLM building in production, not just demos: orchestration, structured outputs, tool calling, evals, tracing, prompt design, injection.

• Works daily with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode or similar), knows their strengths and limits, and stays up to date.

• Testing as a habit: feature and end-to-end tests, CI, verifying your own work through staging to production.

• Cloud and deployment literacy (AWS or similar, Docker, CI/CD). You can operate what you ship.

**Nice to have

**

• Python/FastAPI, Laravel/PHP or Next.js specifically.

• Production migration: third-party service changes, database moves, major-version upgrades, data backfills.

• Operating AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and Linux servers hands-on.

• Eval or observability tooling for agentic workflows.

• Integrations where no documented API exists: webhooks, browser extensions, automation, scraping.

• Legaltech, fintech or another regulated domain.

**What We Offer

**

• Real ownership of core parts of the AI platform in a small team that ships every week.

• Close work with the CTO, product specialists and the lawyers who use what you build.

• Our base is the office in Copenhagen, but regular remote work is fine

**How To Apply

**Apply via The Hub with a short intro, your CV, GitHub and links to things you have built: apps, side projects, something you shipped at work. Next, we send you our skills checklist as a self-assessment plus a few short written questions, then interviews with the team, then an offer. We keep the process short and give you a clear answer at every step.

Your impact begins here

As GLP QA Professional, you will help make sure non-clinical research at Novo is carried out to Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) standards. You will oversee studies, inspect internal and external work, and turn what you see into clear, practical recommendations that keep research reliable and moving. You will shape how quality is built into non-clinical processes, strengthening the foundation for treatments for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You bring a balanced, practical quality mindset. You work systematically and independently, take initiative and stay flexible when priorities change. To succeed in this role, you have:

• Experience as a laboratory technician and relevant qualification, or a master’s degree in science, pharmacy, medicine or a similar field.

• Experience within GLP, for example from quality assurance, GLP-regulated work, non-clinical research or laboratory activities.

• Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and the ability to interpret and communicate regulatory and procedural requirements.

• Strong analytical and organisational skills, with attention to detail and the ability to work systematically and independently.

• Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build constructive relationships with internal colleagues and external Contract Research Organisations (CROs).

• Proficiency in written and spoken English, and confidence in communicating observations, recommendations and quality matters.

Desirable, but not essential:

Experience from industrial drug development.

What you’ll do

You will be the quality partner for GLP-regulated activities, helping colleagues and CROs meet requirements while keeping study quality and compliance protected.

• Perform quality oversight and compliance verification of GLP-regulated activities, including review of study plans, reports, relevant SOPs and documentation from internal areas and external CROs.

• Plan and conduct study-based and process-based internal inspections, including Good Clinical Laboratory Practice (GCLP) activities where relevant.

• Support stakeholders on GLP requirements and general quality matters, including review of GLP action plans from internal and external audits.

• Contribute to maintaining and improving the department’s QMS, including harmonisation, digitalisation and simplification initiatives.

• Communicate observations, regulatory requirements and practical quality recommendations clearly to internal and external stakeholders, and take part in relevant projects, audits and regulatory inspections.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Non-Clinical Quality, a diverse team of 15 skilled colleagues in Søborg. It is one of two sister departments within Process Management, Non-Clinical, IT & AI Quality, part of R&D Quality. In R&D, curiosity, data, collaboration and operational excellence come together to advance scientific ideas towards clinical testing, and Non-Clinical Quality helps make sure the processes behind that work are fit for purpose.

The team provides QMS expertise to a global organisation and works closely with stakeholders across the value chain. You will have many interfaces: research and laboratory colleagues in internal areas, external CROs and other collaboration partners, and teams across the organisation working on improvement projects.

You will work in an international environment where clear communication helps you build trust, create clarity around requirements and keep work moving. Some travel may be required for audits and other GLP QA activities.

What you can expect here

You will build your GLP expertise and take on increasing responsibility, with room to influence how quality is embedded in non-clinical research processes. Alongside day-to-day oversight, you will contribute to cross-organisational improvement projects and share ideas that improve methods, systems and processes.

You will be supported to perform at your best, trusted to work independently and encouraged to make your voice heard. You will grow through practical experience, close collaboration with colleagues and continuous learning.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200.00 to

838,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

Start now

Your impact begins today, so apply by 13 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Engineer - Supply Chain AI Solutions
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Senior Data Engineer, you will build the data foundations that bring Supply Chain AI Solutions to life. You will turn complex requirements into scalable, compliant, production-ready data products and pipelines that power strategic AI use cases for the Supply Chain organisation. Working hands-on in Databricks, you will help move ideas into reliable operation, supporting resilient supply chains and the delivery of treatment to millions of people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You bring strong production delivery experience and the ability to lead the data engineering side of an AI use case, from idea to reliable operation.

• 
A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.

• 
At least 8 years of experience in data engineering, including 3+ years in a senior role.

• 
Deep expertise in Azure Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows and Databricks SQL.

• 
Strong proficiency in Python, Apache Spark and SQL, with proven experience designing and building scalable, production-ready data pipelines and data products.

• 
A solid understanding of BI concepts, dimensional modelling, report and semantic layers, data integrations and self-service data platforms.

• 
Hands-on experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, coding best practices and agile ways of working such as Scrum.

• 
Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders and colleagues at different levels of the organisation.

You are technically curious and enjoy building data products that make a real difference. You are structured, take ownership, drive direction and inspire others to keep improving, and you stay on top of the latest trends in data engineering and AI.

Useful, but not essential:

• 
A Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Professional) certification or another relevant data engineering or cloud certification.

• 
Familiarity with Azure and AWS cloud services.

• 
Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.

What you’ll do

You will set the critical path for Data Engineering within the delivery team to ensure we deliver reliable, production-ready products for our use cases, while sharing your expertise and support team members in adopting best practices. This includes being a hands-on technical contributor who is comfortable in taking the lead in building the required data products for use case from the early phase all the way to production.

• 
Design and implement data and model pipelines in Databricks, using Unity Catalog for governance and medallion architecture patterns to organise and serve reliable data.

• 
Apply an AI-first engineering mindset to create robust, scalable data foundations that are ready for future AI-driven manufacturing and supply chain use cases.

• 
Work hands-on across the full engineering lifecycle, from data modelling and pipeline development to testing, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.

• 
Build high-quality data products and pipelines within our established Databricks platform and engineering framework, with a focus on performance, cost efficiency, governance, compliance and maintainability

• 
Turn complex requirements into clear engineering priorities, identifying the critical path and making pragmatic decisions about what to solve now, what to simplify and what to develop further over time

• 
Mentor and develop data engineers through design sparring, code reviews and practical coaching.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will spend the majority of your time designing, building and improving solutions, while also providing technical guidance to less experienced engineers. You will work closely with the Lead Data Engineer and other senior technical colleagues, contributing to engineering direction while focusing on turning that direction into high-quality, working solutions.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Enterprise AI within Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, stay close to stakeholders and help deliver trusted technology and high quality. Your team is Supply Chain AI Solutions: a small, end-to-end team where data scientists and engineers work side by side, combining analytical depth with the engineering capability to bring solutions into production.

Your closest colleagues are the Tech Lead, the Lead Data Scientist and the AI Product Owner. You will also collaborate with engineers, architects, data scientists and business stakeholders in the Supply Chain organisation, acting as a senior technical contributor across teams. Together, you will make clear decisions, keep delivery moving and turn practical needs into better operational decisions.

The team is cloud-native, working with platforms such as Databricks, Azure and AWS. It values agility, diverse thinking and continuous learning, and its culture is built on feedback, honesty and fun. The role is based in Ballerup, Denmark.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to take ownership, share your voice and shape how data engineering is built within Supply Chain AI Solutions. You will keep growing through continuous learning and career development, working on AI use cases at the forefront of technology, alongside colleagues who raise the bar with you.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

jobs.occupation: Technical Supporter - Wash and Sterilisation Maintenance Support
jobs.description:
# Your impact begins here

As a Technical Supporter, you will take responsibility for resolving technical challenges and ensuring that equipment within Wash & Sterilisation operates reliably. Working closely with skilled workers and production operators, you will combine daily technical support and troubleshooting with driving change requests, validation activities and improvements. You will work independently, take ownership of your tasks and coordinate solutions across disciplines to support stable production and capacity expansion.

# What you’ll bring

You combine a relevant technical or scientific background with curiosity, ownership and a structured approach to problem-solving. Experience from pharmaceutical or another highly regulated environment is valuable, but we also welcome applications from newly graduated candidates.

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant technical or scientific field, such as mechanical engineering, marine engineering, automation engineering or similar.

• The ability to communicate fluently in both Danish and English, verbally and in writing.

• Knowledge of optimising automated processes and a structured approach to solving technical problems, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Preferably, experience with aseptic production and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), or experience from another highly regulated environment.

• Knowledge of and hands-on experience with SAP, programmable logic controllers (PLC) and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems is an advantage.

• A responsible and goal-oriented working style, with the willingness to take the technical lead, challenge existing solutions constructively and follow tasks through to completion. You can manage deadlines, maintain an overview and coordinate activities across professional disciplines.

# What you’ll do

• Take responsibility for ensuring that equipment within Wash & Sterilisation operates as required and supports reliable production.

• Provide and coordinate daily technical support for skilled workers and production operators, working closely with them to resolve equipment and process issues.

• Troubleshoot equipment and process issues, including during shutdowns and breakdowns, and drive systematic problem-solving with relevant colleagues.

• Support capacity expansion and contribute to systematic technical problem-solving.

• Create and drive change requests and validation activities, and implement technical improvements from problem identification through to completion.

• Communicate daily with stakeholders across the organisation, coordinate technical activities and follow up on agreed actions while managing several tasks and priorities.

# Who you’ll work with

You will join the Formulation, Wash & Sterilisation area within Drug Product Manufacturing in Kalundborg. The area supplies washed and sterilised equipment for the subsequent production steps. The team consists of 14 colleagues: 8 skilled workers responsible for equipment maintenance in Formulation and Wash & Sterilisation and 6 technical supporters providing daily support to skilled workers and production operators, as well as working with equipment and process validation.

You will work across disciplines with operators, skilled workers, technical supporters and colleagues in other departments. The environment is busy and collaborative, with an emphasis on trust, mutual respect and solving technical challenges together.

# What you can expect here

You can expect significant individual responsibility and the opportunity to take the lead on technical tasks while drawing on the knowledge of your colleagues. Your work will combine troubleshooting and daily production support with validation, capacity expansion and improvements. Job Title: AI Solution Lead

Department: Enterprise IT and Quality

Location: Ballerup, Denmark

Your impact begins here

As AI Solution Lead in Quality AI, you will turn opportunities for AI into working applications and agents for complex, regulated pharmaceutical quality processes. You will own initiatives from problem definition through to adoption, combining hands-on development with technical and stakeholder leadership. You will also help shape how AI can be shown to be fit for its intended use. Your work helps quality teams act faster, with evidence they can trust.

• Experience structuring business problems, connecting business needs to technical choices and explaining trade-offs to different audiences.

• The ability to build confidence with business leaders, challenge assumptions, negotiate priorities and turn discussions into decisions.

• Work with process owners and users to identify opportunities, define what success looks like and prioritise what to build.

Who you’ll work with

Your closest partners will be pharmaceutical quality process owners and users, engineers, quality experts, IT teams, and business leaders and senior stakeholders. You will be trusted to make decisions on AI/ML approaches, data products and architecture, and to challenge established ways of working when a simpler, faster route meets quality and compliance requirements. Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

**This includes things like...

**

• Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

**Nice to haves

**

• You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• Experience building systemic or open-world games

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

**Practicalities

**

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

Manager – Bespoke Software Development & Adjacent Markets team

Bring your software development expertise and leadership together in a role where people, technology and delivery meet. Lead a team across Aarhus and Warsaw, turn customer needs into customer-tailored Bespoke software solutions and connect Defence expertise with opportunities across Systematic. Along the way, help your team grow and shape AI adoption in developing software.

Your role: Drive software delivery and develop your team

As Manager in the SitaWare Extensions program, you will report to the Senior Director and lead one of the Defence Bespoke Development teams alongside the Adjacent Markets service function.

Your main focus will be delivering customer-tailored Bespoke software solutions that extends SitaWare Headquarters, Frontline and Edge – from software add-ons to system, tactical radio and military equipment integrations. You will take ownership of delivery on schedule, within budget and to the agreed quality. Alongside this, you will act as Project Manager for non-Defence business units in Systematic connecting them with Defence expertise, coordinating and delivering the services they need.

You can look forward to:

• Managing and driving software projects forward by setting priorities, aligning capacity and schedules, tracking progress and budgets, and managing stakeholders, risks and issues

• Developing your team across Aarhus and Warsaw through 1:1s, development talks, creating opportunities for professional and personal growth and recruitment

• Contributing your team's expertise to Defence bids for Bespoke software and representing Defence services in bids across other business units

• Building strong internal partnerships and coordinating communication on SitaWare releases, change requests, defect handling and hotfixes

• Shaping better ways of working, from processes and guides to the use of AI and agentic AI throughout the software development life cycle

You should expect 5–15 travel days a year.

Your team: Bringing SitaWare expertise together

You will lead 8–10 software architects, software engineers and test engineers across Aarhus and Warsaw, including interns and student workers, with a team lead already in place in Warsaw.

You will be part of a wider international network of colleagues across Defence Services, Product Development and other Systematic business units. The Adjacent Markets function draws on specialist expertise from other teams as needed, giving you a broad technical network and connections across the organisation.

You bring: Technical depth, people leadership and the drive to deliver

You combine a solid foundation in software development and architecture with experience guiding projects and leading people. Over several years as a project manager or software engineering manager, you have delivered medium to complex software projects or commercial off-the-shelf software products. You also bring some years of people management experience, an understanding of commercial customer contracts and experience providing services to other business units.

We are also looking for:

• A master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, software design and architecture, data science or cybersecurity, or equivalent

• Experience with system integration software, preferably within Defence, Maritime, Energy/Utilities, Transportation/Logistics or Healthcare, and with AI and agentic AI in the software development life cycle

• Confidence using Jira, D365 Project Management, Confluence and the Microsoft Office suite, including SharePoint, to support planning, collaboration and reporting

• Hands-on experience with technologies such as Java, C#, Angular, Docker, Git, deployment pipelines or cloud platforms is an advantage, along with any Defence domain knowledge from industry or the military

• Fluent English and the ability to bring clarity to technical discussions and collaboration across teams

• A proactive, decisive approach with strong ownership and follow-through, combined with the ability to motivate and involve people, put customers first, embrace change and communicate clearly with stakeholders at every level

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Thomas Frandsen Røjkjær, Director Extensions, Defence.
